scenes.title: Good translation. Too many steps.
scenes.text: AI can make translation feel more natural. So why does getting there still take so many steps?

scenes.title: The copy-paste loop
scenes.text: Select. Copy. Switch tabs. Paste. Ask for a translation. Then find your place again. One small question becomes a break in your flow.

scenes.title: Meet AI Translator
scenes.text: Meet AI Translator for Chrome. Gemini translation, right where you read. A free extension built around one simple action.

scenes.title: Select. Tap Control.
scenes.text: Select the words you want. Tap and release Control. Your translation appears beside the text. Keep the original in view, and keep going.

scenes.title: Meaning first
scenes.text: Because useful translation is about meaning. Not just swapping words. An everyday phrase can become something that sounds natural in your language.

scenes.title: Read with confidence
scenes.text: A work message. A useful article. Details for your next trip. Translate the part you need, without moving your whole task somewhere else.

scenes.title: A little. Or a lot.
scenes.text: A word, a sentence, or a whole paragraph. You choose the selection. Get the answer in place, while the rest of the page stays familiar.

scenes.title: Your language. Your choice.
scenes.text: Choose from one hundred and ten language options. Need another language for this result? Change it in the card. Your saved default stays the same.

scenes.title: Keep the useful parts together
scenes.text: A new phrase. A new question. Translate as you go, with each result close to its source. No growing stack of translation tabs to manage.

scenes.title: Use the result
scenes.text: Copy a translation when you need it. Open the toolbar popup to read the latest result again during your current browser session.

scenes.title: Fits the way you work
scenes.text: Prefer a different key? Choose it in Settings. Or use the right-click menu. Pick your language and Gemini model. Make the workflow yours.

scenes.title: Free extension. Less friction.
scenes.text: The extension is free and open source, with no ads or analytics. Only text you select is sent to Google for the translation you request.

scenes.title: Keep your flow
scenes.text: Less copying. Less switching. More understanding. From the first unfamiliar phrase to the next useful idea, translation stays part of what you are doing.

scenes.title: Install once
scenes.text: To get started, extract the extension download. Open Chrome Extensions, enable Developer mode, and choose Load unpacked. Select the extracted folder.

scenes.title: Get your Gemini key
scenes.text: Open Settings. Get your Gemini API key from Google AI Studio. Review the data details, then choose Agree and connect to Google.

scenes.title: Paste. Choose. Finish.
scenes.text: Paste your key. Choose your target language and model. Finish setup, then refresh your open pages. Your key stays saved on this device.

scenes.title: Select. Control. Understand.
scenes.text: You're ready. Select text. Tap Control. Understand, and keep going. AI Translator for Chrome.
